user_decisions_in_session: Fonts: self-host via npm (chosen over the Google Fonts CDN in the spec and over keeping Source Sans 3)
Heading font: Be Vietnam Pro instead of Poppins, because Poppins has no Vietnamese glyphs (its latin-ext unicode-range skips U+1EA0-1EF1) and Google Fonts offers no vietnamese subset for it
implementer_choices: Kept light/dark: PHASE-00 technology direction and the Phase 01 gate require Light/Dark; the spec defines light only, so dark tokens were derived and contrast-checked

Adapted the landing-page patterns to an admin app: sticky top navbar replaces the sidebar; Overview uses hero + mockup (real scope facts) + roadmap tiles + zig-zag; no 'Đặt lịch demo' CTA; roadmap tiles say 'chưa triển khai' and use a clock badge, not a check mark
One prominent primary button per screen: the 'Tài khoản vừa mời' panel actions became secondary (class change only)
Only weights 400/600/700 (spec rule); labels use 600; spec's 500 captions/labels mapped to 600 or 400
Scroll-reveal animation omitted (optional in the spec; avoids hiding content); motion limited to hover/focus transitions with prefers-reduced-motion respected
Per-weight fontsource CSS (600.css/700.css/400.css) instead of per-subset files, because per-subset files declare no unicode-range and forced every subset to download
contrast_check: Computed WCAG ratios for 16 token pairs per theme before implementation: all >= 4.5 (light: muted 5.78, accent 5.75, white-on-accent 5.75, positive 5.36; dark: muted 7.63, accent 6.93, on-accent 7.83); existing E2E contrast test passes
